scientific_integrity: The universal theorem is supported by an analytic proof. A standalone exact checker verifies finite examples and finite complete sign-chamber certificates. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only unit-conductance finite cycles, independent positive edge-variation weights, unit vertex masses, real signals and p>2; short-cycle weights are shown to exist but not classified, and p<2 is untreated.
title: Six-site rigidity of weighted variation under superquadratic cyclic heat
